description.value: Inn at Laurel Point is a seven-story luxury waterfront hotel on Victoria's Inner Harbour, offering 200 rooms and suites across the Erickson and Laurel wings, all with private balconies and harbour views. The hotel is home to the Aura Waterfront Restaurant + Patio, an indoor pool, and a fitness studio, and is operated by Paul's Restaurants Ltd. Its location on Montreal Street places touring cyclists at the edge of the Inner Harbour with easy access to Victoria's waterfront pathways.
